recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length studio portrait of a female performer in a dynamic pose against a backdrop of swirling, moody clouds. The subject wears a metallic lavender satin jacket and a black ruffled skirt, holding a sheer fabric train. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a dreamlike, theatrical atmosphere typical of mid-80s pop aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a high-contrast, textured cloud background
Warm skin tones and red typography contrasting with cool purple and grey tones
Dynamic diagonal lines created by the subject's arms and flowing fabric
coreInvariants: Soft-focus grain across the entire image
Dramatic, overcast sky backdrop with purple-grey undertones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright metallic belt buckle at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large display text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, follows the arm to the flowing fabric, and ends at the bottom right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space around the subject filled with textured cloud formations to enhance the sense of scale.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted purple-grey and charcoal (background and jacket)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast between the subject and the dark clouds.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Slightly condensed proportions for the display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial letters for the name
Tight kerning with slight overlaps in the display title

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark clouds for maximum legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different scales and weights for top and bottom text.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal line at the very bottom edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp serifs and high contrast of the era
Provides the necessary vertical elegance and stroke weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photo of a woman in 80s fashion (lavender satin jacket, black skirt) posing dynamically against a dark, moody purple-grey cloud backdrop. Use soft focus and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large coral-red serif text at the top center with tight kerning. Add smaller, spaced-out serif text in the same color at the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the top text large and coral-red?
Is the background composed of textured, dark clouds?
Does the subject have a soft-focus, 80s studio glow?

adjustableVariables: Kerning tightness of the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text color is a distinct coral-red, not pure red.
Check that the cloud background has a purple-grey tint.
Confirm the pose is dynamic and full-length.
Verify the typography uses sharp, elegant serifs.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus studio portrait in 80s metallic fashion with a dramatic cloud backdrop and high-contrast coral-red serif typography for a classic pop-diva aesthetic.
